response.sql:
WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.death_country,
        AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p
      ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> ''
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    avg_points_won,
    avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS distance_from_average_of_country_averages
FROM country_averages;

assumptions.assumption: “Award vote records” refers to player_award_vote; blank death countries include NULL and whitespace-only values. The difference is the group average minus the unweighted average of the country averages.
